content:
Threat detection rules deﬁne the conditions that detectors apply to ingested log data to identify
a security event. Security Analytics supports importing, creating, and customizing rules to meet
your requirements, and also provides prepackaged, open-source Sigma rules to detect common
threats from your logs. Security Analytics maps many rules to an ever-growing knowledge base of
adversary tactics and techniques maintained by the MITRE ATT&CK organization. You can use both
OpenSearch Dashboards or the APIs to create and use rules. For more information about rules, see
Working with rules in the OpenSearch documentation.
